subject.title: refactor(ui): consolidate gateway host/status onto the Gateway settings page

question: Should this maintainer-labeled UI consolidation proceed once a real connected Control UI session proves the moved Gateway host panel, search anchor, and status refresh?
rationale: The protected maintainer label requires an explicit human review, while the remaining merge gate is user-visible runtime proof rather than a mechanical source repair.

options.title: Request live UI proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot or short recording of General, Gateway, and settings search in a connected Control UI session before deciding to merge.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A maintainer may accept the listed focused tests and checks without a live artifact, but that waives the normal real-behavior proof gate for this user-visible change.

recommendation.title: Request live UI proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot or short recording of General, Gateway, and settings search in a connected Control UI session before deciding to merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the active consolidation and is the available routing candidate for supplying the missing after-fix UI evidence.
